items.stem: Which TWO are gRPC .NET client performance recommendations? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Reuse a channel for multiple calls rather than creating one per call
options.rationale: Correct: creating a channel is expensive, so reuse it.

options.text: Prefer async/await over blocking with .Result or .Wait()
options.rationale: Correct: blocking can cause thread pool starvation and deadlocks.

options.text: Create a new GrpcChannel for every single call
options.rationale: Creating a channel per call is expensive and discouraged.

options.text: Call gRPC methods synchronously with Task.Result
options.rationale: Blocking on gRPC calls harms performance.

items.explanation: Correct: reuse channels and call methods asynchronously.
